headline: Binance's phased withdrawals continue, with net outflows of roughly $1B to $2.5B depending on the source, as traders look to Tuesday's US midterms and Binance's reserves proof.

market.fearGreed: 30 (Fear) on the alternative.me Crypto Fear & Greed Index

stories.title: Binance withdrawals reopen on 15 networks; outflow estimates range from $1B to $2.5B
stories.summary: Binance restarted withdrawals on Sunday, after halting them on 29 Oct following the hack, beginning with bitcoin. Sources disagree on how much money has left since then: DefiLlama data cited by Bloomberg puts it near $2.5B, while TokenPost reports $1.02B. Either way it is a small share of the roughly $134B-$156B on the platform. There is no date yet for phase two.
points: Phase one covers 15 networks, including Bitcoin, Ethereum, BNB Smart Chain, Tron, Solana, XRP Ledger, TON and Sui. On Ethereum, only ETH, USDT and USDC can be withdrawn so far, per Cointribune.
Net outflows since the restart: about $2.5B out of roughly $134B on the platform, per DefiLlama data cited by Bloomberg. TokenPost reports $1.02B, with $156.192B in total platform assets.
Binance has replaced 95% of affected assets with more than $6.34B of its own money, per Cointribune; Bloomberg's report still gives about 90%. These are Binance's own figures.
BNB was around $707 on Sunday, about 6% below where it was before the attack, per Trending Topics.
The full zero-knowledge reserves check (a public proof that customer balances are fully backed) is scheduled for 3 Nov, per Cointribune.

stories.title: North Korea money trail: about $2.85B frozen, over $3B still in the hackers' hands
stories.summary: US agencies blame North Korea's TraderTraitor group and have published hundreds of wallet addresses for companies to block. Elliptic says $2.85B of the stolen money is verified frozen, but about $3.21B sits in coins that cannot be frozen. Frozen does not mean recovered.
points: Theft estimates: Elliptic $6.43B, Binance about $6.3B, TRM Labs about $6.36B, per CryptoTicker.
The FBI notice lists more than 600 Ethereum addresses, just under 20 Bitcoin addresses and one Solana address, per CryptoTicker.
Elliptic puts verified frozen or seized funds at $2.85B, about 44% of the total, with about $3.21B in assets that cannot be frozen. Bloomberg cites about $3B frozen as of Friday.
About $786M of stablecoins were swapped into ETH and TRX before freezes took effect; the 18,270 stolen BTC sit across 19 addresses and have not been sent to any service, per Elliptic.

stories.title: Markets steady ahead of Tuesday's midterms; crypto PACs spent nearly $170M
stories.summary: Bitcoin held near $78,000 on Sunday after spot bitcoin ETFs lost $643M on Friday, the day after the hack. Tuesday 3 Nov brings both the US midterm vote, which shapes who writes crypto market rules, and Binance's reserves proof.
points: Bitcoin was around $78,000 on Sunday, about 5% below its high before the attack on Thursday, per Bloomberg.
US spot bitcoin ETFs saw -$643.33M on 30 Oct, ending four days of inflows; ether ETFs had their fifth straight outflow day at -$155.85M, per SoSoValue data via Bitcoin.com News.
Three crypto super PACs spent nearly $170M, with Fairshake at $154M, per CoinDesk.
Kalshi gives Democrats a 70% chance of winning both chambers, and major crypto bills still need Democratic votes to clear the Senate's 60-vote bar, per CoinDesk.

briefs.title: Ripple unlocks 1B XRP
briefs.summary: Ripple released 1 billion XRP from escrow at 00:00 UTC on 1 Nov; none had been re-locked by 10:50 UTC, per crypto.news.

briefs.title: Binance's emergency fund
briefs.summary: About half of Binance's roughly $1B SAFU emergency fund is being used, and Binance plans to refill it, per Trending Topics.

briefs.title: Which coins reopened first
briefs.summary: As of 5 a.m. ET Sunday, withdrawals were live for BTC, ETH, BNB, XRP, Base, Doge and Optimism, per CBS News.

briefs.title: China targets crypto corruption
briefs.summary: A Communist Party resolution published 1 Nov orders a crackdown on corruption through virtual currency and blockchain; it adds no new trading ban, per crypto.news.

briefs.title: CFTC chair on offshore exchanges
briefs.summary: CFTC Chair Selig said the hack "proves our exact point" and pushed a federal option for offshore exchanges to register, per Decrypt (30 Oct).

briefs.title: Strategy hints at another buy
briefs.summary: Michael Saylor posted "We found room for even more orange", but no purchase has been announced, per Blockonomi.

briefs.title: Moscow Exchange to list crypto
briefs.summary: The Moscow Exchange plans BTC, ETH and USDT trading from 1 Dec, with limits for retail investors, per crypto.news.
